_comment: 多角色对话。text 为角色原语言台词，translation 为字幕翻译：其他角色英文台词配中文字幕；林远中文台词在回忆段配英文字幕。

lines.speaker: lucia
lines.text: You're the one they call Lynx. The quiet one.
lines.translation: 你就是他们说的山猫。那个不说话的。

lines.speaker: marcus
lines.text: He doesn't talk. Saves ammunition, I suppose.
lines.translation: 他不说话。大概是为了省子弹。

lines.speaker: victor
lines.text: The port is closed. Which means the cargo in there is worth dying for.
lines.translation: 港口封了。说明里面的货值得人拼命。

lines.speaker: lucia
lines.text: Rust Gang patrols the dock. They'll shoot first, then ask who we are.
lines.translation: 锈帮在码头巡逻。他们先开枪，再问我们是谁。

lines.speaker: lin_yuan
lines.text: 走。
lines.translation: Move.

lines.speaker: marlo
lines.text: Four strangers, one boat, no manners. You want passage? Clear my warehouse.
lines.translation: 四个陌生人，一条船，没礼貌。想过河？把我的仓库清干净。

lines.speaker: marcus
lines.text: And if we don't?
lines.translation: 如果我们不干呢？

lines.speaker: marlo
lines.text: Then you can swim with whatever's in the water. Your call, sergeant.
lines.translation: 那你就跟水里的东西一起游吧。你决定，军士。

lines.speaker: lucia
lines.text: He's lying about the boat. But the warehouse is real — I saw crates with Horizon seals.
lines.translation: 船的事他在撒谎。但仓库是真的——我看见印着地平线封条的箱子。

lines.speaker: lin_yuan
lines.text: 查。
lines.translation: Check it.

lines.speaker: victor
lines.text: These manifests are dated after the quarantine. Someone kept shipping.
lines.translation: 这些舱单的日期在封城之后。有人在继续运货。

lines.speaker: marcus
lines.text: Horizon Security. Of course. Private army, private profit.
lines.translation: 地平线安保。当然了。私人军队，私人利润。

lines.speaker: victor
lines.text: Not profit. Specimens. Live ones, in cold storage, labeled by frequency.
lines.translation: 不是利润。是样本。活的，冷藏，按频率编号。

lines.speaker: lucia
lines.text: Frequency? Like a radio?
lines.translation: 频率？像电台那种？

lines.speaker: victor
lines.text: 1.7 gigahertz. Narrow band. Someone is talking to the infected.
lines.translation: 1.7 吉赫兹。窄带。有人在和感染者说话。

lines.speaker: lin_yuan
lines.text: 谁。
lines.translation: Who.

lines.speaker: lucia
lines.text: Rust Gang versus the remnants. They've been at it since dawn.
lines.translation: 锈帮对残警。从天亮打到现在。

lines.speaker: marcus
lines.text: Police held this block for six weeks. That's not nothing.
lines.translation: 警察守了这个街区六个星期。这不容易。

lines.speaker: lucia
lines.text: And Marlo's boys kept the food moving. Pick a side, sergeant. Or pick a corner and hide.
lines.translation: 马洛的人让食物一直有得运。选一边吧，军士。或者找个角落躲着。

lines.speaker: lin_yuan
lines.text: 看。
lines.translation: Look.

lines.speaker: reyes
lines.text: That chip is department property. It has names on it — my people's names.
lines.translation: 那枚芯片是警局的财产。上面有名字——我的人的名字。

lines.speaker: victor
lines.text: It also has a transmission log. Whoever holds it can find the source.
lines.translation: 上面还有传输日志。谁拿着它，谁就能找到源头。

lines.speaker: reyes
lines.text: Then burn it. Some doors stay shut.
lines.translation: 那就烧了它。有些门就该关着。

lines.speaker: marcus
lines.text: Or we walk through and see who's been knocking.
lines.translation: 或者我们走进去，看看是谁在敲门。

lines.speaker: lin_yuan
lines.text: 留着。
lines.translation: Keep it.

lines.speaker: victor
lines.text: The commander's terminal is still warm. Personnel archive, tier four.
lines.translation: 指挥官的终端还是热的。四级人事档案。

lines.speaker: victor
lines.text: Signal adapters. Numbers, not names. Zero-one through zero-nine.
lines.translation: 信号适配体。只有编号，没有名字。01 到 09。

lines.speaker: victor
lines.text: Adapter zero-seven. There's a name in the margin. Someone wrote it by hand.
lines.translation: 适配体 07。页边有个名字。有人手写上去的。

lines.speaker: lin_yuan
lines.text: ……小满。
lines.translation: Xiaoman.

lines.speaker: marcus
lines.text: Lynx. Hey. Breathe.
lines.translation: 山猫。喂。喘口气。

lines.speaker: victor
lines.text: I need two minutes. The terminal is encrypted with a bio-key.
lines.translation: 我需要两分钟。终端用生物密钥加密。

lines.speaker: lin_yuan
lines.text: 她叫什么。
lines.translation: What's her name.

lines.speaker: victor
lines.text: Adapter zero-seven. Lin Xiaoman. Age fourteen. Admitted 2019-09-11.
lines.translation: 适配体 07。林小满。十四岁。2019 年 9 月 11 日入院。

lines.speaker: lin_yuan
lines.text: 她怕黑。
lines.translation: She's afraid of the dark.

lines.speaker: victor
lines.text: The lower level is powered. Life support is active. She may be—
lines.translation: 下层还有电。生命维持系统在运行。她可能——

lines.speaker: lin_yuan
lines.text: 活着。
lines.translation: Alive.

lines.speaker: victor
lines.text: I was going to say 'stable'. But yes. Alive.
lines.translation: 我本来想说‘稳定’。不过……是的。活着。

lines.speaker: lin_yuan
lines.text: 开门。
lines.translation: Open it.

lines.speaker: marcus
lines.text: If we open that door, Horizon knows we're here.
lines.translation: 开了那扇门，地平线就知道我们来了。

lines.speaker: lin_yuan
lines.text: 他们已经知道。
lines.translation: They already know.

lines.speaker: lin_yuan
lines.text: 我开门。
lines.translation: I'll open it.

c4_boss.title: 信号核心 · 对话录音

lines.speaker: signal_core
lines.text: ADAPTER ZERO-SEVEN. LIN XIAOMAN. STATUS: ACTIVE. LOCATION: SUBLEVEL CORE.
lines.translation: 适配体 07。林小满。状态：活跃。位置：核心室下层。

lines.speaker: signal_core
lines.text: SUBJECT REQUESTS A MESSAGE. PLAYBACK AUTHORIZED.
lines.translation: 对象请求留言。回放已授权。

lines.speaker: xiaoman
lines.text: 爸爸，如果你听到这个……我没有害怕。
lines.translation: Dad, if you hear this... I wasn't scared.

lines.speaker: lin_yuan
lines.text: ……我来了。
lines.translation: ...I'm here.

lines.speaker: lin_yuan
lines.text: 那年冬天，她在这条栈桥上学会骑车。
lines.translation: That winter, she learned to ride a bike on this pier.

lines.speaker: lin_yuan
lines.text: 我扶着后座，一直没松手。
lines.translation: I held the seat the whole way. Never let go.

lines.speaker: lin_yuan
lines.text: 她讨厌搬家。每次都说，下次别再骗我。
lines.translation: She hated moving. Every time: don't lie to me again.

lines.speaker: lin_yuan
lines.text: 九月十一号。我送她上学，然后去上班。
lines.translation: September eleventh. I walked her to school, then went to work.

lines.speaker: lin_yuan
lines.text: 那天我没去接她。
lines.translation: I didn't pick her up that day.

ly_memory_4.title: 林远的回忆 · 样本库

lines.speaker: lin_yuan
lines.text: 她怕黑。我答应过，会留一盏灯。
lines.translation: She's afraid of the dark. I promised to leave a light on.

ly_memory_5.title: 林远的回忆 · 核心室

lines.speaker: lin_yuan
lines.text: 小满。爸爸到了。
lines.translation: Xiaoman. I'm here.

truth_1.title: 安全屋 · 第一层真相

lines.speaker: lucia
lines.text: Two rumors, same story. Horizon didn't lose control of the outbreak. They ordered it.
lines.translation: 两条传闻，一个说法。地平线不是控制不住疫情。是他们下的令。

lines.speaker: marcus
lines.text: Ordered it, or let it happen. In my experience, the difference is paperwork.
lines.translation: 下的令，还是放任它发生。依我看，区别只在文件上。

truth_2.title: 安全屋 · 第二层真相

lines.speaker: victor
lines.text: The evidence is consistent. They built a transmitter under the city and tuned it to the fever.
lines.translation: 证据吻合。他们在地下建了发射器，调到了锈蚀热的频段。

lines.speaker: victor
lines.text: Not a weapon. A leash.
lines.translation: 不是武器。是牵引绳。

lines.speaker: lin_yuan
lines.text: 谁的绳。
lines.translation: Whose leash.

truth_3.title: 安全屋 · 第三层真相

lines.speaker: marcus
lines.text: Signal Bureau signed off on the adapters. Children, Lynx. They used children.
lines.translation: 信号局批准了适配体计划。孩子，山猫。他们用的是孩子。

lines.speaker: victor
lines.text: I filed the report. In 2018. It came back stamped 'insufficient evidence'.
lines.translation: 我提交过报告。2018 年。批回来写着‘证据不足’。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The core collapses. 1.7 gigahertz goes silent for the first time in eleven months.
lines.translation: 核心塌陷。1.7 吉赫兹十一个月来第一次安静下来。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Signal terminated. The truth stays buried.
lines.translation: 信号已终止。真相已掩埋。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The coordinates resolve. A list of names scrolls past. One of them is highlighted.
lines.translation: 坐标解算完成。一串名单滚过屏幕。其中一个被高亮。

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Signal received. A response will arrive within 72 hours.
lines.translation: 信号已接收。回应将在 72 小时内到达。
